title: ERock Reports Q3 2026 Results With $8.9 Million Net Income
summary: ERock reported Q3 2026 revenue of $152.767 million and net income of $8.9 million, and reaffirmed its full-year 2026 guidance.
body_markdown:
Net income was $8.9 million, compared with a net loss of $19.768 million in the third quarter of 2025. Adjusted EBITDA, a non-GAAP measure, was $12.6 million, and gross margin was 22.9%, against 9.0% a year earlier. The company said the growth came from increased generator production and installation activity.


ERock reaffirmed its full-year 2026 guidance of revenue of $435 million to $465 million and Adjusted EBITDA of $3 million to $9 million. The company said the midpoint of its revenue outlook represents approximately 2.5x year-over-year growth, and Chief Financial Officer Ian Blakely said the company expects "continued revenue and profitability growth in the fourth quarter."


## Why It Matters for EROC


Blakely said the third quarter "marked an inflection point," describing it as the company's "first profitable quarter as a public company." ERock reported a contracted power system sales backlog of about $1.6 billion at the end of the quarter, compared with about $0.1 billion a year earlier, and said it added power system sales bookings of over $300 million after the quarter closed, pushing backlog to a new record.
